items.title: Ametria Dock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 4, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Ametria Dock here with me today.

ctx.x: Ametria was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 4, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Ametria Dock here with me today.
Thank you for having me here. I’m glad to be here.
